scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Compare multiplicity without requiring order
cases.input_contract: Return whether two Long sequences contain the same values with the same occurrence counts, ignoring order. Do not convert to Set. Empty sequences are equal.
cases.expected: (1,1,2) equals(2,1,1) as a bag but differs from(1,2). Equal count and sum alone are insufficient for(1,3) versus(2,2).
cases.verification: Assert all three comparisons and the empty case against literal expected Booleans.

cases.title: Detect a sum outside Long range
cases.input_contract: Sum Long values with checked addition and an explicit empty identity. Report overflow through ArithmeticException instead of allowing wraparound. Negative values are permitted for this arithmetic contract.
cases.expected: (100,-25,0,100) sums to 175;empty sums to 0;Long.MaxValue plus 1 and Long.MinValue minus 1 both fail.
cases.verification: Assert both exact sums and catch each directional overflow with the supplied exception helper.

cases.title: Promote before arithmetic
cases.input_contract: Return the mathematical value of an Int plus one as a Long. Convert before adding and support the full Int range.
cases.expected: Int.MaxValue becomes 2147483648 L, Int.MinValue becomes-2147483647L, and 0 becomes 1 L.
cases.verification: Assert exact literals at both boundaries and zero; compare with the deliberately too-late conversion example.

cases.title: Define an approximate comparison policy
cases.input_contract: Compare finite Double values using absolute plus reference-relative tolerance. Require finite nonnegative tolerances with IllegalArgumentException on invalid policy. Return false for nonfinite actual or expected values.
cases.expected: 1e8+1 versus 1 e8 passes with atol 0, rtol 1 e-7;1e-9 versus 0 passes with atol 1 e-8;NaN never passes;negative tolerance is rejected.
cases.verification: Assert large-scale and near-zero cases separately, then a strict zero-tolerance failure and nonfinite rejection.

cases.title: Check both conservation and classification
cases.input_contract: Validate a nonnegative/negative partition by checking the full combined bag and each branch predicate. Do not accept equal counts or sums as sufficient evidence.
cases.expected: Input(1,-1,0,1) with accepted(1,0,1), rejected(-1) passes. Dropping a duplicate, replacing(1,3) with (2,2), or placing zero in rejected fails.
cases.verification: Assert the good split and all three distinct counterexamples.

cases.title: Show that an oracle rejects real misconceptions
cases.input_contract: Test a supplied nonnegative-filter candidate against four independent literal fixtures:empty,(0),(-1,0,2),(2,2,-1). Return false if it throws or violates a sequence result. Demonstrate rejection of zero-dropping and deduplicating candidates.
cases.expected: The >=0 filter passes. The >0 filter and a nonnegative-then-distinct implementation fail. A candidate throwing an exception also fails.
cases.verification: Assert one accepted candidate and three rejected candidates, so a success-only harness cannot pass unnoticed.
